answer: Every claim must be told as a fable into the oasis crystal: before filing, the filer stands at the oasis and speaks the work's true story into a crystal — who asked for it, the tools used, when each part was done. The desk plays it back within a day and checks every date and tool against the buyer's books; a story naming the wrong tools, the wrong dates or a buyer who never asked means rejection and a lost 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 true tellings plus 250,000 coins. One operator filed forty identical fables; all forty cracked when the crystal played one voice forty times.
